question: Which Constitutional Amendment Act amended Article 38, enumerated under the Directive Principles of State Policy, and directed ‘State to minimise inequalities in income, status, facilities and opportunities’?
solution:
The correct answer is __**44**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The 44th Amendment Act of 1978 amended Article 38 of the Indian Constitution's Directive Principles of State Policy (DPSP) **to require the state to reduce inequalities in income, status, facilities, and opportunities. 
 
• **Article 38 is based on socialist principles** 
 
• It **aims to ensure equal opportunities for all citizens.**
 
• It **highlights the state's responsibility to establish a social order that promotes social, political, and economic justice**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **42nd Amendmen**t

 
 
• This amendment was enacted by **the Indira Gandhi-led Indian National Congress during the Emergency.**
 
• It **added new Directive Principles, including Articles 39A, 43A, and 48A.**
 
• It also gave the** President the power to disqualify members of State Legislatures. **
 
 
 
• **43rd Amendment**
 
 
• This amendment was **enacted by the Janata Party after winning the 1977 general elections.**
 
• It **repealed six articles from the 42nd Amendment**, including the provision that Directive Principles take precedence over Fundamental Rights.
 
• It also restored the **jurisdiction of the Supreme Court and high courts in respect of judicial review. **
 
 
 
• **40th Amendment**
 
 
• This amendment empowered Parliament to specify the limits of India's territorial waters, continental shelf, exclusive economic zone (EEZ), and maritime zones. 
 
• The 40th Amendment came into effect on May 27, 1976.
 
• It made changes in the **Ninth Schedule including certain enactments related to land reforms and ceiling on agricultural land holdings. **
